result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. I only ran a compile, which succeeded. I didn't run any tests, and no existing test calls this method.

The fix is in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. I added `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery, the same filter the other counts use. I also updated the method's Javadoc to say cancelled orders are excluded.

Nothing else changed. Reps with no purchase orders in the period are still listed with 0, and the ordering is the same. For your example, the report should now show Anna 2 and Bob 1.
